other_conditions: Applicants must belong to Scheduled Castes
Candidates must have passed Matriculation, Higher Secondary or a higher examination of a recognized university/board
Students may study through correspondence or online courses
A scholarship holder must not hold any other scholarship or stipend
All children of any parent or guardian are entitled to benefits
benefits_summary: Financial assistance ranging from ₹4,000 to ₹13,000 per year depending on the course group and hostel status, with an additional 10 % allowance for disabled (Divyang) students.
